records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The trader asks whether the customer needs anything else.
records.localization_note: Keep the concise follow-up when the customer returns to the service menu.
records.Japanese: まだ他に用があるのかい？
records.english: Anything else?

native_lines: Anything else?

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The trader asks whether the customer was only browsing.
records.localization_note: Keep the disappointed but conversational question after the player enters a zero amount.
records.Japanese: …冷やかしかい
records.english: Just browsing?

native_lines: Just browsing?

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The trader thanks the player and promises to put the investment to good use.
records.localization_note: Keep the natural thanks, the promise and the trader’s use of we.
records.Japanese:
ありがたいね
有効に使わせてもらいますよ
records.english: Thanks. We'll put it to good use.

native_lines: Thanks. We'll put it to good use.

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The amount is too little. The trader asks the player to return after earning more.
records.localization_note: Keep the surprise, apology and invitation to return in that order.
records.Japanese:
うんっ！？
申し訳ないが、その金額じゃ
どうにもならんよ
もっと稼いだら、また来てくれよ
records.english: Huh? Sorry, that won't be enough. Come back when you've earned more.

native_lines: Huh? Sorry, that won't be enough.
Come back when you've earned more.

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The trader notes the player cannot trade without market share, expresses surprise and praises the offer, then asks how much.
records.localization_note: Give the prerequisite, surprise, appreciation and amount question their own spoken beats.
records.Japanese:
シェアがないと交易もできないのに
投資してくれるんですか…
奇特な人だねえ
で、いくら投資してくださるんで？
records.english: You need market share to trade. You still want to invest? That's generous of you. How much will you put in?

native_lines: You need market share to trade.
You still want to invest?
That's generous of you.
How much will you put in?

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The trader recognizes a prospective investment, flatters the player and asks for an amount.
records.localization_note: Keep the existing flattery and give the amount question a complete line.
records.Japanese:
投資してくれるってのかい？
さすが、他の連中とはどこか違うと
思ってたよ
で、いくら投資してもらえるんだ？
records.english: You're going to invest? I knew you were different from the rest! How much will you put in?

native_lines: You're going to invest? I knew
you were different from the rest!
How much will you put in?

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The cargo holds are full, and the trader asks the player to buy less.
records.localization_note: Keep the reason and the practical response together.

積荷倉庫が満杯だよ！
買うものを減らしてくれよ
records.english: Your cargo holds are full! You'll have to buy less.

native_lines: Your cargo holds are full!
You'll have to buy less.

records.speaker: Trader
records.source_meaning: The buyer lacks enough money to complete the purchase.
records.localization_note: Keep the plain warning without adding a scold.
records.Japanese: あんた、それじゃ金が足りないよ
records.english: You don't have enough money.

native_lines: You don't have enough money.
